_comment: Training configuration for prism_ml.models.train. The pipeline trains ONLY on trusted, reviewer-assigned labels (see docs/FARM_DATA_COLLECTION_AND_RETRAINING.md).

abstention._comment: The abstention threshold is chosen on out-of-fold validation predictions, not invented: the smallest max-probability threshold whose accepted predictions reach target_accepted_macro_f1 while keeping coverage >= min_coverage. If no threshold qualifies, the model is rejected.
